+    def _is_all_or_any_call(self, node):
+        """Check if a node is an all() or any() call with a comprehension."""
+        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
+            return False
+        if not isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
+            return False
+        if node.func.id not in ("all", "any"):
+            return False
+        if len(node.args) != 1:
+            return False
+        arg = node.args[0]
+        # Check if the argument is a comprehension
+        return isinstance(arg, (ast.GeneratorExp, ast.ListComp, ast.SetComp, ast.DictComp))
+
+    def _unroll_all_or_any(self, assert_, call):
+        """Unroll an all() or any() call into individual assertions."""
+        is_any = call.func.id == "any"
+        comp = call.args[0]
+        
+        # Extract the element expression and generators
+        if isinstance(comp, ast.GeneratorExp):
+            elt = comp.elt
+            generators = comp.generators
+        elif isinstance(comp, ast.ListComp):
+            elt = comp.elt
+            generators = comp.generators
+        elif isinstance(comp, ast.SetComp):
+            elt = comp.elt
+            generators = comp.generators
+        elif isinstance(comp, ast.DictComp):
+            elt = comp.key
+            generators = comp.generators
+        else:
+            return None
+        
+        # Build the unrolled assertions
+        # We need to create a series of nested for loops with assertions
+        
+        # Start with the innermost assertion
+        inner_assert = ast.Assert(elt, None)
+        
+        # Wrap with generators and their conditions
+        body = [inner_assert]
+        for generator in reversed(generators):
+            # Create the for loop
+            for_loop = ast.For(
+                target=generator.target,
+                iter=generator.iter,
+                body=body,
+                orelse=[]
+            )
+            body = [for_loop]
+            
+            # Add if conditions
+            for if_clause in reversed(generator.ifs):
+                if_stmt = ast.If(
+                    test=if_clause,
+                    body=body,
+                    orelse=[]
+                )
+                body = [if_stmt]
+        
+        # Set line numbers
+        for stmt in body:
+            set_location(stmt, assert_.lineno, assert_.col_offset)
+        
+        return body
